changes.text: Every tick now says why a stock moved, in plain words: "Subscribers up 0.6% this week", "3D live yesterday (18k peak)", "Eased after player buying since the Open tick". You'll find it on each stock's page, in the market report, under Last tick on the Activity tab, and in short form in the stocks table.
The lines only explain the tick that just happened, from the channel numbers and trading everyone can already see. They never show the hidden target or hint at what the next tick will do.
